confirmation_exposure.scope: Known project output roots, metadata-only; acquired raw scans excluded; no claim about unrelated external projects

calibration.folds: leave-one-COMPOSE_CAL-scene-out; fit each source temperature on the other scene
calibration.fusion_weights: equal over available sources, no weight search
calibration.objective: scene-balanced NLL on unique strict-IoU>0.5 source-available object correspondences
calibration.refit: once on both COMPOSE_CAL scenes after cross-fitted nomination; regression/confirm use those fixed temperatures

data.confirm_requires: new composition selection lock, unchanged method settings, actual exposure check
data.fit_usage: read-only historical provenance; no new visual run or head training

gates.m6: On COMPOSE_CAL only: ((M3 weakly dominates Q_COMBINE in mean uAP and mIoU with one strict gain) OR (M4 similarly dominates Q_GAIN)) AND (M5 similarly dominates Q_COMBINE)
gates.nomination: best technically complete, effective-change composition by CAL mean uAP, mean mIoU, smaller mean required logical six-crop request count, fixed method order
gates.promotion: report frozen nominee only; mean-positive, every-scene nonnegative, and tradeoff statuses separately; do not deploy automatically

M1.rule: replace N0 only on available positive Q_GAIN == available S_SIGLIP2_AREA; otherwise keep

M2_CAL.rule: same mixture and sources as M2_RAW, separate source temperatures

M2_RAW.rule: equal arithmetic probability mixture over genuinely available sources

M5.controller: odd paid slot COMBINE, even paid slot GAIN; deterministic work-conserving fallback

models.q_gain: existing native-v10 FIT/CAL-selected checkpoint AND standardizer; no refit

query.combine_mutation: call native_combine_candidates exactly once per valid frame, including quota=0
query.frozen_trajectory: all ordered paid attempts, masks, frame barriers; never reconstruct from final retained IDs only
query.mixed_preference: odd attempted slot COMBINE; even GAIN; fall back to other list if exhausted
query.mixed_ratio_interpretation: 50:50 preferred slots, not a guarantee of 100 realized selections per lane
query.native_result_barrier: one per frame; rank once before paying/retrieving the batch
query.readout: area-weight raw six-crop means, then final L2 normalization; class0 with no successful evidence
query.retain: existing top10 overlap/frame/request order with irreversible lineage drops

readout_review.current_static_area: raw six-crop means, area-weighted, final normalization; repair already present at reviewed revision
readout_review.n0_pool: original saved native order, last8 of top10 and its minimum-observation rule
readout_review.query_pool: existing retained top10 with irreversible drops

release.large_artifacts: external content-hash manifest plus exact regeneration commands
release.push: ordinary push, compare full local HEAD against ls-remote for task branch
release.self_reference: experiment commit A in tracked reports; actual final release commit B in external publication_receipt.json
